gate: all frozen merge/vector/batch/ranking gates and real HTTP contract smoke must pass for the same graph
scope: Embedding-call latency including tokenization, excluding HTTP/Qdrant and token-count preflight. Native serializes batch3; ONNX batch3 is direct padded graph inference. Public ONNX HTTP backend retains one-text-per-forward, so graph batch3 is not an HTTP batch speed claim. Hash verification precedes the separately timed model initialization.
limitation: Shared host, sequential processes, one run per profile; no production forecast.
